item.name: Recupera os dados de localizacao de um determinado device de acordo com seu msisdn. Backend: LBS LOCATION BASED SERVICES

request.name: Recupera os dados de localizacao de um determinado device de acordo com seu msisdn. Backend: LBS LOCATION BASED SERVICES

header.description:
(Required) Header query string (LGPD compliant) onde são informados os campos de identificação da pesquisa de designacoes. A identificação é composta de 3 campos obrigatorios e dois opcionais:

  * MSISDN (required) - array com msisdn
    
  * locationMethod  (not required) - Define o metodo de localizacao desejado
    * De 0 a 99: AGPS (Nao disponivel agora)
    * de 100 a 499: TA/RTT
    * 500 a 999: Cell ID
  
  * locationType (not required) - Define se voce recebe a localizacao atual do device ou recebe a ultima localizacao armazenada no banco de dados
      o  CURRENT – forca a localizacao atual
      o  LAST – a ultima localizacao registrada no banco de dados
      o  CURRENT_OR_LAST – tenta a localizacao atual primeiro, se falhar pega a ultima localizacao registrada no banco de dados
      o  LAST_OR_CURRENT – obtem o ultimo registro no banco de dados, se nao conseguir tenta trazer a localizacao atual

response.name:
Unprocessable Entity - Identify business errors that can be detailed according to backend system rules. 

The possible values are:
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-001: The request can not be handled because of a general problem in the location server.
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-002: An unspecified error used in case none of the other errors apply. This can also be used in case privacy issues prevent certain errors from being presented.
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-003: The requesting location+based application is not allowed to access the location server or a wrong password has been supplied.
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-004: Unknown subscriber. The user is unknown, i.e. no such subscription exists.
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-005: Absent subscriber. The user is currently not reachable.
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-006: The request can not be handled due to congestion in the location server.
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-007: Too many position items have been specified in the request.
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-008: A protocol element in the request has invalid format. The invalid element is indicated.
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-009: The position request has invalid syntax.
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-010: The requested service is not supported in the Location Server.
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-011: A protocol element in the request has an invalid value.
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-012: A protocol element attribute in the request has a wrong value.
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-013: The request can not be handled due to congestion in the mobile network.
  * API-LBSDEVICESLOCATIONS-014: A protocol element specified in the position request is not supported by the Location Server, or the position result is not supported by the LCS Client.

description.content:
Version Author Date Changes
1.0.0 EngDB 2023-06-29 [LBS Device Locations] Versão inicial
## Objetivo Gestão de localizações de dispositivos móveis na plataforma LBS (Location Based Services) da Engenharia. ## Público-Alvo Servico de localizacao de devices. ## Provedores LBS (Location Based Services) ## Contexto em que a API se Insere Fornecer informacoes de localizacao de despositivos que estao localizadas no LBS para o microservico DeviceLocation.
